title: 第16章 野心第17章 保护费
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
“大师兄，大师兄快来啊，老三疯了！”
易天听到声音快步从内院走出，看着被丰连紧紧抱住的石修说道：“老三，怎么了你这是！”
看到易天，丰连连忙说道：“大师兄，老三疯了啊，刚才看到地板上的狗屎，居然想要扑上去吃！”
易天脸色一变，老三难道是练武练到走火入魔了？这要是师傅知道了，那还得了！
“呜呜...呜呜呜！”被丰连捂住嘴的石修想要说什么，但是一句话都说不出来，只能呜呜几声。
见到这一幕，易天让丰连先把手拿开，听听石修怎么说。
丰连手刚一拿开，石修连忙解释道：“谁说我要吃了，我就只是看看而已！我怎么可能会吃呢！”
闻言丰连跟易天也是松了口气，还好不是疯了，不然他们两人估计就要被师傅打个半死了。
“吓我一跳，我还以为是大师兄最近布置的练武时间太长了，你承受不了发疯了呢！”丰连看着石修说道。
“嗯？”易天眼角瞥了眼丰连，丰连连忙收起笑容，装出一副不苟言笑的样子。
易天无奈的摇了摇头，也不管丰连，看着石修说道：“老三，走吧，去内院，让师傅看看你最近练武的成果！”
说着易天就走向后院，丰连幸灾乐祸的看了眼石修，也跟了上去。
看着两人离去的背影，石修慢慢红了眼眶：“真好，大家都在一起说说笑笑的，要是能一直这样就好了。”
这时石修已经无比确信，这就是梦境，原来这就是我遗憾！
快步追赶上两人，然后双手搭在两人的肩膀上：“大师兄，二师兄，等下要是师傅动手，你们记得给我求情啊！”
“哈哈哈哈，老三，师傅要动手我们可不敢拦着啊。”
“等下你表现的好些，师傅肯定不会动手的。”
......
夜晚。
师兄弟三人坐在屋顶上一起看着星星。

“大师兄，二师兄。”
“嗯？”易天跟丰连转头看向石修。
“你们今后有什么打算吗？”石修犹豫了下，还是问出了心中的问题。
丰连哈哈一笑：“当然是待在武馆当中啊，平时教教那些师弟，然后给师傅养老。”
石修看向易天：“那大师兄你呢？”
易天看着满天星星沉默了一会说道：“我想去内城。”
虽然心中早已有了答案，但是真的听到易天说出口，石修还是不免内心一颤：“大师兄，能不去吗？”
易天转头看着石修还稚嫩的脸庞笑着说道：“你不懂，我已经练骨了，你二师兄也快练骨了，再加上师傅，我们武馆就有三个练骨境界。”
“而且你的天赋也不错，想必最后也会练骨，那就是四个练骨！”
“你觉得我们武馆能同时培养四个练骨吗？”
“所以想要更多的修炼资源，就需要去内城，那边拥有更好的发展空间，而且师傅的功法只能到练骨，之后的境界怎么办？难道就一辈子徘徊在练骨境界？”
“当然，我不是说武馆不好，但是内城相对来说更加的海阔天空！”
content_en:
"Eldest Brother, Eldest Brother, come quickly, the third child is crazy!"
Yi Tian heard the sound and walked out of the inner courtyard quickly. He looked at Shi Xiu who was hugged tightly by Feng Lian and said, "Lao San, what's wrong? What are you doing!"
Seeing Yi Tian, Feng Lian hurriedly said: "Elder brother, the third child is crazy. He just saw the dog shit on the floor and actually wanted to pounce on it and eat it!"
Yi Tian's expression changed. Could it be that the third child has gone crazy in his martial arts practice? If the master knew this, that would be fine!
"Woooo...oooooo!" Shi Xiu, whose mouth was covered by Fenglian, wanted to say something, but he couldn't say a word and could only whine a few times.
Seeing this scene, Yi Tian asked Feng Lian to take his hands away first and listen to what Shi Xiu said.
As soon as Feng Lian took his hand away, Shi Xiu quickly explained: "Who said I wanted to eat? I was just watching! How could I eat!"
Wen Yanfenglian and Yi Tian also breathed a sigh of relief. Fortunately, they were not crazy, otherwise they would have been beaten half to death by their master.
"I was shocked. I thought it was because the martial arts training time arranged by Senior Brother recently was too long. You couldn't bear it and you went crazy!" Feng Lian looked at Shi Xiu and said.
"Huh?" Yi Tian glanced at Feng Lian from the corner of his eyes, and Feng Lian quickly put away his smile and pretended to be serious.
Yi Tian shook his head helplessly, and regardless of Feng Lian, he looked at Shi Xiu and said, "Lao San, let's go to the inner courtyard and let the master see the results of your recent martial arts training!"
Saying that, Yi Tian walked towards the backyard. Feng Lian looked at Shi Xiu with gloating eyes and followed him.
Seeing the two people leaving, Shi Xiu's eyes slowly turned red: "It's great. Everyone is talking and laughing together. It would be great if it could always be like this."
At this time, Shi Xiu was extremely convinced that this was a dream, and it turned out that this was my regret!
He quickly caught up with the two of them, then put his hands on their shoulders: "Senior Brother, Second Senior Brother, if the master takes action later, please remember to beg me for mercy!"
"Hahahaha, third child, if the master wants to take action, we don't dare to stop him."
"When you behave better later, the master will definitely not take action."
...
night.
The three brothers sat on the roof and looked at the stars together.
"First senior brother, second senior brother."
"Huh?" Yi Tian and Feng Lian turned to look at Shi Xiu.
"What are your plans for the future?" Shi Xiu hesitated for a moment, then asked the question in his mind.
Feng Lian laughed: "Of course I stay in the martial arts gym. I usually teach the juniors and then support the master in his old age."
Shi Xiu looked at Yi Tian: "What about you, Senior Brother?"
Yi Tian looked at the stars in the sky and was silent for a while before saying, "I want to go to the inner city."
Although he already had the answer in his heart, when he actually heard Yi Tian say it, Shi Xiu couldn't help but tremble in his heart: "Senior Brother, can you not go?"
Yi Tian turned to look at Shi Xiu's still immature face and said with a smile: "You don't understand, I have already practiced bone training, and your second senior brother is about to do bone training. Together with the master, our martial arts school has three bone training realms."
"And your talent is pretty good too. I'm sure you'll also be able to do bone training in the end. That's four bone training!"
"Do you think our martial arts school can train four bone practitioners at the same time?"
"So if you want more training resources, you need to go to the inner city. There is better development space there, and the master's skills can only reach the bone training state. What will happen next? Do you just linger in the bone training state all your life?"
"Of course, I'm not saying that the martial arts gym is not good, but the inner city is relatively brighter!"
